title: Complex number
summary: Complex numbers extend the reals with a square root of −1.

content.plain: Complex numbers extend the reals with a square root of −1.
content.exact: ℂ can be constructed as pairs (a,b)∈ℝ² with (a,b)(c,d)=(ac−bd,ad+bc); i=(0,1) satisfies i²=−1.
content.caveat: Complex numbers have no field order extending the usual real order.
